domain_claim: choose_width computes exactly the number of nodes emitted by lower_canonical_choose — guaranteed parity between precomputed layout and body lowering.
notes: Mismatch causes graph validation failure or silent target corruption. Kani harness verifying choose_width result equals actual node count emitted. Proptest for random branch configurations.

domain_claim: Last body node of each branch has next=common_next — no fallthrough into adjacent branch body.
notes: Failure mode: matched branch body executes, then continues into next branch's body instead of post-choose 'next' step. Kani harness checks all body edge nodes' next pointers.

domain_claim: otherwise target is not within any branch body span — it must point after all body nodes.
notes: Unlikely but dangerous: otherwise target landing inside body range causes partial body execution. Kani harness verifies otherwise >= id + choose_width.

domain_claim: choose_width and body_width use checked_add — no usize overflow can produce a spuriously small StepIdx.
notes: checked_add is the sole mitigation. Kani harness proves that for any collection of branches within fanout limit, choose_width either returns Ok(value) with value >= 1, or Err(StepIndexOutOfRange).

domain_claim: Body lowering never produces a StepIdx that wraps or exceeds u16::MAX.
notes: Current step_idx(v) returns Err if v > u16::MAX. Layout computation catches overflow before lowering begins. Kani harness verifies that for valid layout widths, all computed StepIdx values are in [0, u16::MAX].

domain_claim: All condition slots and body output slots are distinct — no SlotIdx is reused across branches.
notes: SlotCompiler tracks all allocated slots monotonically. Flux refinement: slot_count after lowering = slot_count_before + number_of_output_slots. Kani harness verifies SlotCompiler deduplication.

domain_claim: Condition slots (from slot_from_text) and body output slots (from record_slot) are disjoint sets.
notes: If condition slots and body output slots overlap, body execution corrupts condition values. Kani harness verifies disjointness across all branches. Mitigated by the fact that body outputs use fresh slots while conditions use pre-named slots.

domain_claim: ChooseSlot fanout limit of 64 is enforced at both lower_canonical_choose and lower_choose — no bypass path exists.
notes: Defense in depth: two checkpoints. Kani harness verifies both functions reject branch counts > 64.

domain_claim: SlotBranch.condition slot always holds Bool at runtime — compile-time slot resolution ensures only boolean-named slots are used as conditions.
notes: Current gap: no compile-time slot type tracking. Verus spec could model slot type invariants. Kani harness can verify replay_choose_slot behavior for all SlotValue variants. This seed may identify a needed type-system extension.

domain_claim: When otherwise is None and all branches are false, replay_choose_slot returns Internal error — this is intentional, not a bug.
notes: This is spec conforming behavior. Kani harness verifies that the error is returned for the all-false-no-otherwise case across all branch counts.

domain_claim: ChooseSlot dispatch is sequential — no slot races possible during branch body execution within a single workflow run.
notes: Not behavior-affecting in the default model. Loom could verify choose dispatch under concurrent slot access if future work adds parallelism. Currently, choose is single-threaded per run.

domain_claim: slot_from_text fails closed for unknown when strings — no arbitrary slot access.
notes: Fuzz target: random when strings against a slot name map. Verify SlotNotAvailable runtime error for unknown names. This is already handled at compile time but defense-in-depth fuzzing confirms no bypass.

domain_claim: YAML depth and node limits prevent exponential blowup from deeply nested choose bodies.
model_boundary: vb_yaml depth limit → vb_compile layout computation
notes: Fuzz target: deeply nested choose YAML with body steps at each level. Verify either successful compile (within limits) or graceful error (limits exceeded).

domain_claim: For any valid ChooseBranch set, the number of nodes emitted by lower_canonical_choose equals choose_width(branches).
notes: Central correctness claim. Kani harness: generate valid branch configs, compute width, run lowering, assert node_count == width. Proptest: random configs with shrinking.

domain_claim: Final IR contains zero YAML condition strings — all conditions are numeric SlotIdx values.
notes: Anti-hallucination rule from explorer. Kani harness iterates over all SlotBranch.condition fields and verifies they are SlotIdx values (not string-derived). Trivially true by type; harness confirms type system guarantee.
